title: 5 Pond Cypress Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 5 Pond Cypress Way is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12)- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Vehicles- 6 Seater Electric Cart - Electric Vehicle Charger- Natural Gas Grill- Open Floor Plan- Exterior Shower- Located in the Camp District of WaterColor- 4 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor- 6 Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access- 5 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Escape to the tranquil Camp District of WaterColor at 5 Pond Cypress Way, your ultimate vacation retreat. This exquisite 5-bedroom, 4 full and 2 half-bath home welcomes you with a spacious open layout, perfect for gatherings. Enjoy cozy evenings in the living area, whip up culinary delights in the expansive kitchen, and share meals in the generous dining space for up to ten—all fully equipped for effortless entertaining. Unwind in the luxurious first-floor king suite, complete with a private bath featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Upstairs, discover four charming bedrooms: a serene king suite with an en-suite bath, a delightful twin bedroom, a bunk room for four, and a versatile bedroom with twin-over-full bunk beds and a cozy living area for kids. Convenient half baths on each floor add to your comfort. Step outside to the inviting porch, perfect for sipping morning coffee or hosting barbecues with loved ones. Just a 4-minute stroll to Camp WaterColor and a quick 6-minute golf cart ride to the Beach Club, adventure is always within reach. Explore the picturesque 30-A area on the six adult bikes provided. Embrace comfort, luxury, and unforgettable moments at this idyllic home away from home. Book now with Sanders Beach Rentals and start creating cherished memories with your family!
